article: For each question, write the correct answer. Hi Johann,  I really need your help with the history homework that Mr Wilson gave us (27) …………… few days ago. I really need to start it. I (28) …………… been too busy to think about it until now, I'm afraid! Mr Wilson said it might be a good idea to go through our ideas with a friend before we start doing any work on the project. What (29) …………… you think? I know it would be really helpful to show you what I'm planning. I can look at yours too (30) …………… you think that could be useful. (31) …………… you know, out of all our school subjects, history is (32) …………… one I like most, so I really want to do my best!  Let me know, and we can arrange a time, OK?

explanations.27:
原因：“a few days ago” 表 “几天前”，固定搭配。
词汇点：a few + 可数名词复数，表 “一些”，如 a few books.
explanations.28:
原因：现在完成时 “have been too busy”，强调持续到现在的状态。
语法点：have/has done，如 I have lived here for ten years.
explanations.29:
原因：特殊疑问句 “what do you think?” 表 “你觉得如何？”
语法点：what do you think of...? 询问看法，如 What do you think of the film?
explanations.30:
原因：条件句引导词，“如果你觉得有用，我也可以看你的”。
语法点：if 引导条件句，如 If you agree, let me know.
explanations.31:
原因：“as you know” 固定短语，表 “如你所知”。
词汇点：as 表 “正如”，如 As we all know, the earth is round.
explanations.32:
原因：最高级 “the one I like most”，“最喜欢的科目”，the + 最高级。
语法点：the + 最高级，如 the best student.
